Most of men fear helping school girls. For instance, I have witness at least three men who have assisted these girls upto university level by paying their fees and other expenses but on graduation day, the girl comes along with her husband. During the time when she was in school, she could come to the boy’s home during long holidays. We also have such from our village. She spends all her holidays at the man’s home then afterwards she gets back to school. But during graduation she finds a man who matches her class apart from the man who has been supporting her during her through her education. Currently most men fear assisting school girls. Secondly, they fear those young girls due to the stringent laws in place protecting them against defilement. This is because after helping her they could indulge in activities that could lead to pregnancies which is the most common result. Pregnancy is visible to everyone and you cannot hide. This could lead to prosecution of the man but for the girls who are out of school, her pregnanacy could not be a problem because you could talk over it and agree if you are getting married or not. Some maen even abandon such cases in case of girls out of school which could be an advanatage to them. Even if they help these girls they don’t expect anything in return but if something bad happens they could abandon the situation. In conclusion, the boys prefer assisting girls out of school.

Let us not mince words, I just want to be open and speak the truth. I am a bodaboda operator, there is no operator that could offer lift to a girl even up to Akala without expecting something in return. This is because, one could meet an elderly man trekking along the road and upon hearing the man asking for lift, chwaa, he speeds off. (laughter) He would take his phone to the ear pretending not to hear the request. We normally such theatrics as bodaboda, and what I know is that we the bodaboda meet so many girls on the road and we carry them and we meet them in our line of work and they fall for us because of money. We, the bodaboda, have money every time as we get it easily, even right now I have money that I have been working for since from morning. After a short distance and I already have money, so whenever I carry a girl I just ask for her mobile number and it starts from there with the money I have. So, it is very difficult for bodaboda to carry a girl free of charge, it is impossible.
